parts.text: One dwarf can mine 20 pounds of ore per day with his bare hands.
He can mine twice as much with an iron pickaxe and 50% more with a steel pickaxe than with an iron pickaxe.
How many pounds of ore can 60 dwarves with steel pickaxes mine in a month with 28 days?

parts.text: Doctor Jones is scheduling his time for Monday.
He is spending 9.5 hours at the clinic where he works that day.
He has to do rounds to check on inpatients staying at the clinic, which takes twenty minutes per inpatient, and he has ten appointments, which take thirty minutes each.
How many hours will Doctor Jones have left to update his records if he has 9 inpatients at the clinic?

parts.text: Jaime is a computer programmer for a company that currently has employed 100 people.
Senior programmers are paid more than junior programmers.

If the number of Junior programmers is 2/5 of the total number of employees, and they are each paid $2000 per month,  the total amount of money the company pays to all the programmers per month is $224000.How much more are senior programmers paid than junior programmers?

parts.text: Out of the 150 teachers on the school basketball court, 60% are history teachers.
